==jvajvo classes==
If for a given lujvo you find more places than listed here it means this lujvo is not a jvajvo.

# -gau suffix. '''x1 x2 x3 x4 ... brodygau''' unwraps into '''x1 gasnu lo nu x2 broda x3 x4 ...'''. Equivalent to '''x1 jai gau broda fai x2 x3 x4 ...'''
# -ske suffix. '''brodyske''' = ''x1 is the broda science, broda-ology studying particular subject x2''
# -pre suffix. Roughly corresponds to English "-er" or "-man" like "fireman" etc. Can describe only persons, not non-conscious pbjects.
# '''cmacma''', '''brabra''' mean ''very small'', ''very big''. Unwrap according to [[la tsani|La Tsani]]'s Flipping Principle.
# '''tce-''' prefix. '''tcebroda''' unwraps into '''mutce lo ka ce'u broda'''
